- The signed 2026 Renewal Order Form puts that at $1,850 a seat before discount. The 14% discount from Amendment 1 still applies, which brings it to about $1,591 a seat.

Once you tell me whether Tobias should get the current rate, the proposed 2027 rate (marked as proposed), or both, I'll save the draft to him at trendle@pemberline.com. Your approval covers either one, so I won't need anything else.
